description: Sort every regular saved test of the project, with its runs and schedules, into the current test categories again by its name, in the background (Test Lab, Categories, Sort every test again). Category names stay; tests moved by hand may move again. Uses an LLM and counts against a daily limit. Returns the background job; follow it with list_jobs.

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
